title: Monklish Font
description: Adds the Monklish alphabet from Bloons Tower Defense 6 as a font and banner patterns.
body:
This mod adds a **font based on the** [**Monklish alphabet**](https://www.bloonswiki.com/Monklish) found in [Bloons Tower Defense 6](https://store.steampowered.com/app/960090/Bloons_TD_6/), as well as **28 banner patterns** based on the 28 characters from it.

The font can be used by any [JSON text](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Text_component_format) (it has id `monklishfont:monklish`), such as with the `/tellraw` or `/title` commands on in custom item names. If you have [Bookshelf](https://modrinth.com/mod/bookshelf-lib), you can also use the `/bookshelf font` command for easy uses.

The font supports:
* All 26 latin letters A to Z (upper and lowercase are displayed the same),
* Exclamation (!) and question mark (?),
* Arab numerals and various punctuation which are unchanged from the base font (as they are used in Monklish text in game).

**To get the banner patterns, craft the Banner Pattern item** and use it in a Loom, as you would with any other. It is crafted with one each of Paper, Brown Dye (the monkey), and Red Dye (the bloon).

![Screenshot of all 28 banner patterns in various colors.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/7onP4OOe/images/c1583b2d0e5c7c1ba3bf2a53df0a42c13f916438.png)

This was inspired by Darkhax's font mods, such as [Unown Font](https://modrinth.com/mod/unown-font).
